title: The 9:03 to York

pre.en: What was missing from Chen's backpack at the end?
pre.zh: 最后，小陈的背包里少了什么？

intro: 一篇新概念式的小故事：小陈跟室友 Tom 坐火车回约克，座位被占、背包落在了别的车厢。读的时候留意被动语态：车上的规矩怎么说——车票「被查」、热饮「被卖」、丢的包「被交上来」，都不用说是谁干的。结尾有个小意外。

sentences.en: It was 8:55 on Saturday morning, and Tom and I were running late for the 9:03 to York.
sentences.zh: 那是周六早上八点五十五，我和 Tom 眼看要赶不上九点零三分去约克的火车了。

sentences.en: He was taking me home to meet his family for a week, and I couldn't wait to see the city.
sentences.zh: 他要带我回老家见家里人，待一个星期，我早就等不及想去看看那座城市了。

sentences.en: The train was fully booked, but luckily Tom had reserved two seats in coach C.
sentences.zh: 车票全卖光了，好在 Tom 提前在 C 车厢订了两个座位。

sentences.en: We jumped on board at the back just as the doors closed.
sentences.zh: 车门关上的那一刻，我们从车尾跳了上去。

sentences.en: But when we got to coach C, two students were sitting in our seats, fast asleep.
sentences.zh: 可走到 C 车厢一看，两个学生正坐在我们的座位上，睡得正香。

sentences.en: I put my backpack on the rack above them, and Tom had a quick look at the little screen.
sentences.zh: 我把背包放到他们头顶的行李架上，Tom 凑过去看了一眼座位上方的小屏幕。

sentences.en: "Reservations are only kept until the train leaves," he read.
sentences.zh: 「订座只保留到开车为止，」他念道。

sentences.en: "So we're too late."
sentences.zh: 「所以我们来晚了。」

sentences.en: We ended up standing by the doors in coach H, and Tom showed me the ropes.
sentences.zh: 最后我们只好跑到 H 车厢的车门边站着，Tom 顺便给我讲了讲坐火车的门道。

sentences.en: "Tickets are checked during the journey," he said.
sentences.zh: 「车票是在路上查的，」他说。

sentences.en: "Hot drinks are sold in coach F, and nobody talks in the Quiet Coach."
sentences.zh: 「热饮在 F 车厢卖，安静车厢里谁都不说话。」

sentences.en: "Oh, and always keep an eye on your bag."
sentences.zh: 「对了，一定要看好你的包。」

sentences.en: I nodded, like someone who knew exactly where his bag was.
sentences.zh: 我点点头，一副很清楚自己的包在哪儿的样子。

sentences.en: Then the wifi went down, and a guard came along and looked over our tickets.
sentences.zh: 后来车上的 Wi-Fi 断了，一位列车员过来把我们的票查了一遍。

sentences.en: Somewhere near Peterborough, I suddenly realised I'd left my backpack behind in coach C.
sentences.zh: 快到彼得伯勒的时候，我突然反应过来：背包落在 C 车厢了。

sentences.en: My laptop was in it, and my passport, and the cheese sandwich I'd made at six.
sentences.zh: 里面有我的笔记本电脑、护照，还有我早上六点做的奶酪三明治。

sentences.en: "Don't panic," Tom kept saying.
sentences.zh: 「别慌，」Tom 一个劲儿地说。

sentences.en: "It must still be on the rack."
sentences.zh: 「肯定还在行李架上。」

sentences.en: It wasn't.
sentences.zh: 并不在。

sentences.en: On our way back, we ran into the guard, and she promised to ask around.
sentences.zh: 往回走的路上，我们碰到了那位列车员，她答应帮我们问问。

sentences.en: "Bags go missing on this line all the time," Tom said.
sentences.zh: 「这条线上丢包是常事，」Tom 说。

sentences.en: "But they're usually handed in."
sentences.zh: 「不过一般都会有人交上来。」

sentences.en: "Seriously?" I said.
sentences.zh: 「真的假的？」我说。

sentences.en: "That only happens in films."
sentences.zh: 「那是电影里才有的事吧。」

sentences.en: At York, the guard was waiting on the platform with my backpack.
sentences.zh: 到了约克，列车员拿着我的背包在站台上等着。

sentences.en: Everything was still there — laptop, passport, charger — except my sandwich.
sentences.zh: 东西都在——电脑、护照、充电器——就是三明治没了。

sentences.en: In its place, someone had left a note.
sentences.zh: 原来放三明治的地方，有人留了张字条。

sentences.en: "Sorry. Long journey. Very nice pickle."
sentences.zh: 「抱歉。路太长了。酱很好吃。」

cards.note: to be later than you planned
to be very excited about something and want it to happen soon
if a train, hotel or restaurant is fully booked, there are no seats or rooms left
cards.tip: 说「订满了」不用 full booked；也可以只说 booked up。主语是火车、酒店、餐厅，不是人。
cards.example: Every hotel near the station is fully booked this weekend.

cards.note: 英式英语里 coach 还指长途大巴；火车车厢也可以说 carriage。

cards.zh: 在车上；在船上；在飞机上
cards.note: on or onto a train, ship or plane
cards.tip: get on board 上车，be on board 在车上；后面要接交通工具时用 on board the train。
cards.example: There's no food on board, so bring something to eat.

cards.note: 全称 luggage rack；放东西用 on the rack。

cards.text: have a quick look at sth
cards.note: to look at something for a short time
cards.tip: have a look at 的 at 不能丢；quick 可以换成 closer（仔细看看）。
cards.example: Can you have a quick look at my CV before I send it?

cards.note: 动词是 reserve：reserve a seat；订餐厅也说 make a reservation。

cards.zh: 教某人入门；带某人熟悉门道
cards.note: to teach someone how to do a job or how things work in a new place
cards.tip: ropes 用复数、带 the；学会门道是 learn the ropes。
cards.example: My new manager showed me the ropes on my first day.

cards.note: to watch something or someone carefully so that nothing bad happens
cards.tip: eye 用单数，不说 keep eyes on；也可以说 keep an eye on the time（留意时间）。
cards.example: Could you keep an eye on my laptop while I get a coffee?

cards.note: if a computer system goes down, it stops working
cards.tip: 说网络、服务器、App 停止工作；恢复了可以说 It's back up。
cards.example: The website went down for an hour this morning.

cards.note: 英国火车上查票、管车门的工作人员；guard 还有「警卫」的意思。
to read or examine something quickly in order to check it
to forget to take something with you when you leave a place
cards.tip: 东西放在 leave 和 behind 中间：leave my bag behind；落在哪里用 in / at：behind in the car。
cards.example: I left my umbrella behind at the restaurant again.

cards.note: while you are going somewhere
to experience a problem or difficulty, often one you did not expect
to disappear, so that nobody knows where something or someone is
cards.tip: 主语是丢的东西：My phone went missing，不说 I went missing my phone。英式英语常用。
cards.example: My keys went missing last week, and I still haven't found them.

cards.zh: 上交；交给（失物招领、老师、前台）
cards.note: to give something to a person in charge, for example something you found or a piece of work
cards.tip: 被动 be handed in 很常用：丢的东西「被交上来」；交作业也说 hand in your homework。
cards.example: Someone handed my wallet in at the front desk.

cards.note: 「在站台上」用 on：on platform 4。
动词 charge 充电：My phone is charging.
英国的 pickle 常指一种褐色的酸甜蔬菜酱，和奶酪一起夹三明治；美式英语里 pickle 多指腌黄瓜。
